story_type: winter basket hoist off a fishing boat in big seas
hook: 65 miles out in January, the only way off was up.
narration: Sixty-five miles off Nantucket, in January, the only way off this boat was straight up.
A sixty-two-year-old fisherman aboard needed a hospital.
An MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod flew out to find the boat in the swells.
The basket rides down on a steel cable, and the hoist operator steadies it by hand while he talks the pilot into position.
With the fisherman inside, the basket swung back up through the rotor wash.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew brought him to Rhode Island Hospital in stable condition.
title: Hoisted off a fishing boat in January
description:
On Jan. 8, 2021, a Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a 62-year-old fisherman off his vessel about 65 miles southeast of Nantucket, Massachusetts, and brought him to Rhode Island Hospital in stable condition.
